specification.question: Resolve target-schedule confounding and test stronger future learning signals in the planning-facing encoder.
specification.decision: Four controls x3seeds x512updates. Fixed-target controls were registered from a code audit; two stronger-auxiliary last6 controls were added from the initial train-only gradient diagnostic (weighted auxiliary norms only1.2-2.6% of planning), before inspecting learned development metrics. No result-dependent architecture selection. Preserve original36runs and prior2-control registration.
specification.scope: Additional encoder controls: two matched-target last2 arms and two last6 arms changing only auxiliary weight0.05 to0.5. Same cached images, teacher, learning rates,512updates, paired seeds, fixed original planner. Combined total48 trained encoders.
specification.teacher: Frozen official planning encoder, inspired by fixed-teacher latent learning; no EMA and not a reproduction of SALT's pixel-trained teacher.
specification.target_policy: Uniform32 or16 highest observed motion/planner-Jacobian regions plus16 uniform remaining regions. Planner sensitivity is a current-feature proxy, not future utility labels. Future camera frames are teacher-only. All four future tubelets supervised with validity masks; horizon adaptation is not claimed.
specification.mask_policy: Masked auxiliary stream removes all4 native patches of32 spatial regions BEFORE the first frozen encoder block. Two deterministic views per window/strategy; IDs preserved through RoPE. Dense current stream always feeds planner; all comparisons use identical observed images and teacher targets. Current control has identical four queries and future validity mask but current targets.
specification.analysis: Official PDM for all24 final checkpoints plus original on same192windows; scene-macro ADE, recording bootstrap95CI, paired seeds, observed command/speed strata with two cutoff sets. Shared fixed linear future probe and encoder-only command intervention with planner status held fixed. No counterfactual safety or causal scene understanding claim.
